summary.intent: Execute Phase 20 (vault-migration) which implements a v2 binary blob format for vaults across core, API, desktop (Rust), and web client, then verify the implementation works end-to-end.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans executed successfully. Migration works correctly (confirmed via DB). Two bugs were discovered and fixed post-execution: (1) folder sync crashing on v2 blobs, (2) recovery tool IPNS resolution using garbled CIDs from delegated routing API.

repo: NestJS does not auto-log incoming HTTP requests, making API calls invisible in server logs — confirmed calls only via direct DB query
orval codegen generates `{ [key: string]: unknown } | null` instead of `string | null` for nullable string fields in OpenAPI specs — `as unknown as string` casts are the correct workaround, not a bug
The local Kubo IPFS node exposes delegated routing at port 5001 (`/api/v0/name/resolve`) but NOT on the gateway port 8080 — IPNS resolution for recovery must use port 5001
IPNS records published on local Kubo do not automatically propagate to the public DHT — public gateways (ipfs.io, delegated-ipfs.dev) cannot resolve them
The delegated routing API returns CBOR-wrapped records, not raw protobuf — parsing as raw protobuf returns garbled binary CIDs

code.finding: fetchAndDecryptMetadata blindly JSON.parsed IPFS blobs without checking for v2 binary format first — caused SyntaxError crash after vault migration
Same v2 blob parsing bug as folder.service.ts — both needed detectBlobVersion + stripV2Header before JSON.parse
Migration IIFE in PATH B succeeded silently on first login — no console output because NestJS request logging is disabled
fetchFromIpfs could return undefined on non-200/non-404 responses (loop falls through) — detectBlobVersion then crashes on undefined.length. Added explicit error throw.
serialize_vault_blob_v2 lacked key length bounds checks — HIGH security finding, now returns Result with validation
InitVaultRequest and VaultResponse derived Debug which exposed encrypted key material in logs — replaced with custom Debug impls that redact sensitive fields
Desktop vault init double-wrapped rootFolderKey with ECIES — same key wrapped twice with same public key. Simplified to reuse first wrap.

workflow: When API calls appear missing from logs, query the database directly to confirm whether they actually executed
Playwright browser automation can be used mid-session to grab auth store state (private keys, vault keypairs) for manual testing without adding UI code
OTPs appear in plain text in NestJS dev server terminal output and can be retrieved from background task output files
GSD debug command (gsd-debugger subagent) adds diagnostic console.log statements to trace execution flow, then removes them after root cause is found

friction: Phase init failed because working directory was cipher-box-phase-20 but init ran in cipher-box — required manual directory detection
Security review API connection refused on first attempt, required re-invocation
Migration appeared to fail silently (no /vault/migrate in logs) causing significant investigation time — root cause was NestJS not logging requests by default
Recovery tool had multiple layered bugs: undefined return from fetchFromIpfs, garbled CID from CBOR-vs-protobuf parsing mismatch, then IPNS record not on public DHT
orval codegen generates wrong TypeScript types for nullable strings — requires manual type casts that look like bugs
Local IPFS/IPNS setup doesn't propagate to public DHT, making recovery tool testing on public gateways impossible
open_items: M-1: Recovery tool private key not zeroed from memory after use
M-2: No deduplication guard on concurrent migration from multiple browser tabs (race condition possible)
M-3: ECIES re-wrap on every root folder FUSE publish — optimization requires caching wrapped key in AppState
L-1: Zero-length key accepted by v2 blob deserializers
L-2: No SRI hashes on CDN scripts in recovery.html
Recovery tool IPNS resolution on local dev requires pointing IPNS gateway to Kubo port 5001 — not obvious from UI, consider documenting or auto-detecting
Device registry sync fails with CryptoError: Invalid registry format — pre-existing schema mismatch between stored and expected format (captured as todo)
Bin IPNS name 404 resolution failure — pre-existing issue (captured as todo)
